headline: United Bankshares Beats Q3 Profit Estimates but Misses on Revenue
summary: Regional lender United Bankshares posted third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst expectations, although total revenue fell short of consensus projections.
why: United Bankshares is a major regional banking institution in the eastern United States. Regional bank performance provides insight into net interest margin trends and commercial loan demand.

impacts.name: United Bankshares
impacts.why: Strong earnings were offset by lower-than-expected revenue figures.
